purpose: Define a provider-independent, content-addressed CI evidence record so hosted CI systems can produce portable verification evidence without owning check identity, source identity, release authority, or capability promotion.
core_invariants: CI evidence is bound to an exact AXIOM source state; a provider run URL or numeric run id is observation provenance only.
A passing CI conclusion is evidence, not governance approval, release promotion, or capability promotion.
Large logs and reports may remain separately protected or replicated; the canonical CI record retains exact byte commitments and opaque protected references.
Runner and environment facts are descriptive evidence and do not become actor identity or authority.
claim_boundary: This contract does not execute CI, fetch provider APIs, download logs, or mutate provider state.
This contract does not independently verify runner hardware, operating system, or environment claims beyond their supplied evidence commitment.
This contract does not treat a CI pass as release authority, governance approval, or capability promotion.
This contract does not require private logs or security reports to be exposed inline.
